# Guiding Point Consulting

> Guiding Point Consulting is a certified WBE/MBE digital strategy and web consulting firm based in Tampa, Florida. We partner with public sector prime contractors as a subcontract delivery partner, and work directly with mission-driven nonprofits, to modernize websites, build AI-supported content systems, and train the people who run them.

Our belief: technology should bring people closer, not replace the connection between them. AI is getting smarter. We build the systems that keep people at the center of it.

Primary audiences:
- Public sector prime contractors seeking a subcontract delivery partner for digital and AI components
- Nonprofits and mission-driven organizations modernizing their digital presence

Certifications: Women-Owned Business Enterprise (WBE) and Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), certified through State of Florida OSD/DMS. SBA certification in progress.

Contact: hello@guidingpointconsults.com — Tampa, Florida, serving clients nationwide.

## Services

- [All Services](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services): Overview of every Guiding Point service and how engagements are structured
- [Website Modernization](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services/website-modernization): Audit, roadmap, and rebuild of public-facing websites for clarity, usability, accessibility, and AI discoverability (AEO/GEO)
- [AI Content Operations](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services/ai-content-operations): SOPs, prompt libraries, workflows, and governance for content teams
- [AI Team Training](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services/ai-team-training): Plain-language, role-specific AI training for non-technical staff
- [Custom AI Chatbots](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services/custom-ai-chatbots): Mission-aware assistants trained on an organization's own FAQs, programs, and documents
- [Fractional Digital Strategy](https://guidingpointconsults.com/services/fractional-digital-strategy): Ongoing senior digital strategy leadership on a part-time basis
